customSections.label: What Bellevue Families Should Know
customSections.content: A few entries in BSD's staff and district calendar need context before families use them for childcare, transportation, or appointments.

groups.label: Conference days are early-release days
items: Elementary students attend school November 16–20 but are released early for conferences. The June 17 conference day applies only to preschool and is not a day off for K–12 students.

groups.label: Quarter and semester endings are regular school days
items: BSD marks November 6, January 28, and April 9 as regular school days. Students attend school as usual on these dates.

groups.label: Wednesday early release and staff schedules
items: BSD separately states that schools release early on Wednesdays. The Wednesday sections in the 2026–27 PDF describe how staff use those afternoons; they do not create additional student schedule changes. As of our August 7 review, BSD's start-and-dismissal page still lists 2025–26 bell times, so we don't add the individual staff-category dates as separate calendar events.

customSections.label: Conditional Emergency Make-Up Dates
customSections.content: These dates only become school days if BSD uses them to make up a closure. October 9 and March 19 have published cutoff rules; June 1 and June 24–25 are also reserved.

whatsNew.title: What Changed From 2025–26
content: Grades 1–12 still begin on September 2, while the kindergarten first day moves from September 5 in 2025 to September 8 in 2026.
The 2026–27 PDF adds a separate September 9 first day for preschool; the live district calendar also names September 8 as the Evergreen Transition Program opening.
Elementary conference early releases expand from four dates in November 2025 to five consecutive weekdays, November 16–20, 2026.
The first-quarter, semester, and third-quarter ending dates are now explicitly labeled as regular school days.
Spring Break moves from April 6–10, 2026, to April 12–16, 2027, while the scheduled last day remains June 23.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Bellevue School District start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Students in grades 1–12 start Wednesday, September 2, 2026. Kindergarten WA Kids runs September 2–4, kindergarten and the Evergreen Transition Program start September 8, and preschool starts September 9.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Bellevue School District Winter Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. Students return Monday, January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Bellevue School District Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs April 12–16, 2027. Students return Monday, April 19.

calendarFaqs.q: Are Bellevue elementary conference dates no-school days?
calendarFaqs.a: No. November 16–20, 2026, are labeled elementary conference early-release days. Students attend on a shortened schedule; families should confirm dismissal and transportation times with their school.
Yes. June 23, 2027, is the scheduled last day, but BSD reserves June 24–25 as emergency make-up days. October 9, March 19, and June 1 also have conditional emergency status.

calendarFaqs.q: Does a downloaded calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The ICS file is a one-time download, and BSD says its printable PDF is also a static copy. Use the subscription controls on the official district calendar page for updates.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 7, 2026, against the official BSD calendar page, both pages of the 2026–27 Staff & District Academic Calendar PDF, and the district's current start-and-dismissal and preschool pages.
sourceReviewDetails: The live BSD calendar identifies September 8 as the first day for both kindergarten and the Evergreen Transition Program. The printable PDF names kindergarten on that date and lists preschool separately on September 9.

BSD separately states that all schools release early on Wednesdays. The PDF's Wednesday categories describe how staff use those afternoons and are not added as separate student calendar events; the detailed K–12 bell-time table was still labeled 2025–26 during this review.
BSD's preschool page describes a four-hour Wednesday schedule and includes 2026–27 program information, but it does not provide a complete 2026–27 K–12 dismissal table.

The staff collaboration table contains a May 26, 2026 entry inside the 2026–27 calendar. Because the year conflicts with the surrounding dates and the entry applies only to staff, we don't include it in the student calendar.
BSD states that printable calendar downloads are static. The ICS file on this page is also a one-time snapshot and does not subscribe to later changes.
